title: Document test-run-only Stop retry and idle capacity recovery
outcome: The test-run feature guide gives the same idle Stop contract that the routes implement, including rollback before a successful write, retry of a pending retirement when a background acknowledgement fails, and idle capacity recovery.
acceptance: The guide distinguishes synchronous rollback from a pending background retirement whose pause can be confirmed by repeated Stop.
It includes the provider-capacity retry exception to an ineligible idle Stop returning 409.
